tests: R8 an included member is carried with its container record, its archive and the archive's token, each under materials/<sha>, in the order held
R8 the outsider's check over the bag's files: manifest-sha256.txt, then unzip -p the archive's path against the member's digest, then openssl ts -verify on the archive's token
R8 a member of a nested archive is carried outward to the outermost: each archive's container record, bytes and token
R8 each it cannot carry is answered in unheld, never refused: a container naming another document or no archive digest, an archive not held, an archive token not held
R8 an archive held inline as text at its digest is held inline under kind archive; read back by R3
R8 a document that is not a member is held exactly as R1 states: another method with a container block, unpacked with no block

R8 (N768; K2145) two members of one archive: the archive and its token are written and listed once, and answered in files once under each member's ref; an archive whose record names an archive already walked ends the walk

R15 what gets queued: one row per digest for each receipt that is not a fetch (a knock, an unpacked file, a route no ruling names), inside the receipt's transaction; a fetch queues nothing; a second receipt adds no row

R15 copyBatch: a knock PDF whose image carries EXIF is cleaned by doc-clean; the copy is held under <store>/obscured/<sha>, labelled derived and naming its original, never registered; the original is unchanged; the answer counts each outcome

R15 copyBatch asks R62 again (fetched since: public, no copy); a register byte count over CLEAN_MAX_BYTES is refused DOCUMENT_TOO_LARGE unread; a photo found queued leaves the queue; oldest first, at most limit (default and bound DOCUMENT_COPY_BATCH_MAX)

R15 a read of the evidence store that fails leaves the document queued, tried no sooner than DOCUMENT_COPY_RETRY_MS after; with no evidence store bound copyBatch answers DOCUMENT_COPY_NO_STORE (C-141.11) and derives nothing

R15 copyWake: null while nothing is queued; now while a queued document has not been tried; else the earliest retry instant, never before now; read from the tables, so it survives a restart; writes nothing, never throws
R16 documentCopy answers synchronously each state: public, clean, copy, refused, pending, undetermined, photo; a miss is queued (its one write) and answered pending; never throws

R17 onCopyWork: a listener registers once and is called once with {at} (copyWake as it then stands) after an act that queues a member document commits; never inside a rolled-back act; one that throws or rejects changes nothing; no call names a member or a file

R1 a knock PDF with EXIF is carried as its copy only: the copy held derived, kind obscured; no byte, text, token or archive of the original; carried whole it is answered unheld; a fetched PDF is held whole
R8 a member document carries none of R8's files, carried whole (clean) or as its copy; a walk that reaches an archive this copy did not fetch carries it for no material and stops

R13 (T39) kind document: a row stating a member document's copy that is not its current copy lapses, and a member document carried whole whose state is not clean or public; undetermined lapses (fail closed); each row names its kind

R19 the withdrawal history is read whole, page by page through its cursor; a withdrawal on a later page answers the row

R19 fail closed: a withdrawal history that cannot be read whole, or a `since` that is not record-core's instant, answers every row of the block withdrawn; a block stating no row answers null, asking nothing

R19 (T47; N947) a flag opened after `since` and cleared before the read answers undisclosed through accepted-work's flagHistoryOn (its R9), as the signer, each distinct (ref, edition) asked once; the same flag disclosed in the block answers none; a flag both open now and in the history is named once

R19 (T47; N947) fail closed: a flags' history answering absent (none registered), unreadable, not an object, complete not true or flags not a list answers that (ref, edition) withdrawn, its flags not named; every other row is judged as before

R20 marksLapsedSince: a mark added after `since` and withdrawn before the read answers the row (the copy changed since), though the stated copy is derived again and R13 reads it standing; its control (nothing since, or an act whose copy is the stated one) answers none; writes nothing
R20 a member document's copy other than the stated one after `since` answers the row (kind document), though the stated copy is recorded again before the read; its control answers none
R20 with nothing changed since `since`, marksLapsedSince answers exactly what R13 answers at the read, every kind of row in the block's order; at most 200
R20 fail closed: a `since` that is not record-core's instant answers every row stating `obscured` lapsed; a history that cannot be read answers the row lapsed; never throws

R21 sourcesLapsedSince: a row that did not hold at `since` though it holds at the read is answered, and one that holds at `since` but not at the read; its control (holding at both) answers []; with nothing changed it answers what R5 answers at the read; writes nothing
